en: The image shows a historical black-and-white view of a public square with classical architecture. In the foreground, there is a prominent column topped with a statue and a round basin at its base, possibly a fountain. In the background, there is a domed pavilion with columns, and several people are seated on benches or walking. The square is surrounded by elegant multi-story buildings with balconies. The text at the bottom left reads: 'Bad Pyrmont, Hauptquelle und Augenbrunnen.'
